plugins.title: Applications and plugins
plugins.description: The platform's optional applications and the installed plugins. A plugin is installed and enabled without a restart.

autoDisabled.title: Plugins disabled automatically: {count}
autoDisabled.body: They failed too many times in a row: {names}.

list.title: Plugins
list.empty: No plugins installed. Upload a .zip package below.
list.disableAllConfirm: Disable all plugins? You can re-enable each one.

upload.title: Upload a plugin
upload.body: The package (.zip) is checked before anything else: size, paths, manifest, compatibility, dependencies, migrations and certification. It is installed only after you confirm.
upload.hint: Maximum 8 MB. For an update, upload the new version of the same plugin.
upload.network: The upload failed. Check your connection and try again.
upload.noTrusted: No certification keys configured (GCS_PLUGIN_TRUSTED_KEYS): every package is treated as not certified.

capabilities.none: The plugin asks for no capabilities.

db.title: Own database
db.body: Creates tables in a separate schema, with a dedicated PostgreSQL role. It cannot read or change the site's tables.

events.title: Events
events.body: Learns when something happens on the site (new post, new member, chat message) and reacts in the background.

filters.title: Filters before saving
filters.body: Can change or reject posts before they are saved.

widgets.title: Widgets
widgets.body: Adds widgets you can place on pages with “Edit page”.

pages.title: Site pages
pages.body: Has its own pages on the site (addresses /p/…).

api.title: API routes
api.body: Receives JSON requests from the browser (addresses /api/plugins/…).

acp.title: ACP pages
acp.body: Has its own pages in the admin panel.

menus.title: Menus
menus.body: Adds links to the site menu or the user menu.

jobs.title: Jobs
jobs.body: Runs periodic or on-demand tasks in the background.

settings.title: Settings
settings.body: Has its own settings, editable in the ACP.

permissions.title: Permissions
permissions.body: Declares group permissions, shown in ACP → Groups.

hooks.title: Extension points
hooks.body: Adds content to specific places in the interface (e.g. the author card).

http-out.title: Requests to other sites
http-out.body: Can send requests to external services, so it can send out the data it sees. Internal addresses are blocked.

client-css.title: CSS styles
client-css.body: Brings its own CSS, confined to the plugin's container (it does not change the rest of the site).

client-js.title: JavaScript in the browser
client-js.body: Runs JavaScript in visitors' browsers on the plugin's pages and can act on their behalf. GCS certified plugins only.

templates.title: Templates
templates.body: Reserved: the plugin's templates, for the template engine.

media.title: Own media files
media.body: Receives images, videos and audio files uploaded from its pages. GCS checks them by content, re-encodes images and enforces size limits and a quota.

appearance.title: Member appearance
appearance.body: Can change how members look across the site: name style, avatar frame, banner, card background and profile extras. GCS validates everything (only colours and the plugin's own files).

post.title: Posts through the community bot
post.body: Can publish topics, replies, private messages and chat messages as the community bot. You can turn it off any time in ACP › System › Community bot.

general.title: General plugin (new servers)
general.lead: The same plugin for any server not added yet: it only has the site address, no key. Installed on a server, it announces itself here, under "New servers detected"; once approved it receives its key and starts sending data. By default it only collects data.

enroll.title: New servers detected
enroll.lead: Servers with the general plugin asking for a key. The site checks with a query that a real game server answers at that IP:port; the name and map are the ones reported by the server. Only approve servers you recognise.
enroll.duplicateHint: Several requests for the same IP:port: one of them may be fake.
enroll.differs: the name or map differs from the reported ones
enroll.approveUnverified: The query did not confirm a game server at this address. Approve anyway? The server will receive an API key.
enroll.approvedNew: Approved: the server was added. The plugin receives its key within a minute.
enroll.approvedAttached: Approved: attached to the chosen server. The plugin receives its key within a minute.
enroll.blockConfirm: Block the IP {ip}? Its pending requests are rejected and new ones are no longer accepted.

clans.title: Clans
clans.lead: The community clans: approving new ones, locking, archiving and disbanding, limits and each clan's log.

empty.pending: No clan is waiting for approval.

clans.rejectConfirm: Reject the clan “{name}”? The clan is deleted and the founder gets the reason.
clans.lockReason: Lock reason (optional, shown on the clan page)
clans.memberLimitHint: Empty = based on the leader's groups (ACP → Gaming → Clans → Settings → Groups).
clans.disbandText: The clan is deleted with its members, requests and images. The private forum is deleted if empty, otherwise it stays for the staff only. The log keeps the data.
clans.disbandConfirm: Disband the clan “{name}”? This cannot be undone.

settings.maxPerMemberHint: 1 = a single clan. Pending clans count too.
settings.leaveCooldownHint: How long a member who left or was removed waits before joining another clan. 0 = no pause.

charsets.alnum_symbols: Latin letters, digits and the symbols - _ . ! ? # * ~ ^ '
charsets.unicode: Letters and digits in any alphabet

settings.requestDays: Days until a join request expires
settings.archiveInactive: Automatic archiving after how many days without activity
settings.archiveInactiveHint: 0 = off; otherwise between 14 and 730 days. Activity = members active on the site or changes in the clan.

settings.officerRightsHint: A right removed here also disappears from the clans that had given it.

rights.events: Register the clan for events and tournaments

settings.forumParentMissing: Choose the category for clan forums: without it no private forum can be created.

forumModes.auto: Created automatically when the clan is activated

bridge.unsupported: The bridge (server plugin) exists only for Counter-Strike 1.6 and Counter-Strike 2.

keys.lead: The plugin signs every request with the server key; the secret never travels over the network and is not stored in plain text. Rotating keeps the old key valid for 10 more minutes; revoking is immediate. Max 5 active keys.
keys.freshHint: Copy it into the plugin config now: it is shown only once.

keys.revokeConfirm: Revoke the key? The plugin using it stops immediately.

identity.modeHint: In mixed mode, without ReAPI / Reunion on the server, every player is non-Steam (Steam cannot be proven).
identity.cs2Hint: On CS2 every player is Steam; the mode changes nothing.
identity.nameIds: Players without a valid ID (LAN, PENDING) become name identities
identity.nameIdsHint: Name identities have low trust: anyone can use a name.

vip.title: VIP on the server
vip.lead: Members with an active VIP subscription in the enabled groups get the flags on their Steam and non-Steam identities. When it expires, the rights disappear at the next sync.
vip.flagsHint: AMXX letters (default b, the reserved slot). On CS2 they become CounterStrikeSharp permissions.

setup.title: Installing the plugin
setup.cs16: CS 1.6: AMX Mod X 1.9+ with the AmxxEasyHttp module. The easiest way: download the plugin for this server (above); the archive is fully filled in.
setup.cs2: CS2: Metamod:Source 2 and CounterStrikeSharp. The easiest way: download the plugin for this server (above); the archive is fully filled in.
setup.security: Use HTTPS. By default the plugin only collects data; the lists of the management modules (admins, bans, VIP) are also kept locally on the server, so a site outage does not stop them.

package.title: Plugin for this server
package.lead: A ready-to-install archive: the compiled plugin, the config with the site address and a new API key (created now, only placed in the archive), the install note and the licence. On the server: upload the files, restart, done.
package.download: Download the plugin for this server

modules.title: Optional modules — only if you want GCS to manage the server
modules.lead: By default the plugin only collects data (statistics, matches, admins present) and changes nothing on the server: admins, bans and commands stay the server's own. Turn a module on only if you want GCS to take over that part; the plugin receives it within a minute. On the server, gcs_allow_manage 0 (CS 1.6) or "AllowManage": false (CS2) keeps them off regardless.

names.sanctions: Bans, mutes and gags from GCS

hints.admins: The admins from the ACP replace the rights from users.ini / admins.json (including name + password admins).
hints.sanctions: Sanctions given on the site are enforced on the server: banned players are kicked on join, mutes, gags.
hints.vip: VIP flags are added on top of the server's rights (the existing ones stay).
hints.mixReady: On mix servers: /ready starts the match and GCS restarts the game.
hints.commands: The gcs_ban, gcs_mute, gcs_match … commands (CS2: css_gcs…) and the admin action log.

upload.saved: {count, plural, one {# image saved.} other {# images saved.}}

removal.deleteHint: The account and its private data are removed. Posts can stay, signed “Deleted member”.
removal.deleteLead: What {name} has and what happens to each part. The account is blocked right after you confirm.
removal.mergeHint: Moves everything this account has into another account of the same member, then deletes this one.

removal.memberScheduled: The member asked for their account to be deleted; it is deleted on {date} unless they cancel.
removal.memberInProgress: The account is being deleted or merged and is blocked.
removal.memberIsTarget: The account {name} is being moved into this account.
removal.scheduledSupersede: The member already asked for deletion (scheduled for {date}). An operation started here replaces it.
removal.hasEmpty: The account has no content or app data.

DELETE_CONTENT.title: Delete content too
DELETE_CONTENT.body: Also deletes the topics they started (with all replies), their posts, statuses, chat messages and files. Meant for spam accounts.

removal.keepMessages: Keep the private messages they sent
removal.keepMessagesHint: Deleted by default. When checked, they stay in the other members' conversations, signed “Deleted member”, without IPs.
removal.confirmLabel: Type the member's name to confirm: {name}
removal.deleteWarning: Deletion cannot be undone. The account is blocked at once; data is removed in the background.
removal.blockedSelf: You cannot delete your own account from the ACP. Use Settings → Account → “Delete account”.
removal.blockedSelfMerge: Your own account cannot be the source of a merge (it would be deleted). Swap source and target.
removal.blockedRoot: A Root Admin can only be deleted or merged by another Root Admin.

chat_pro.days: Days with messages in the chat ranking

online_time.days: Days with time online in the ranking

notes.topic_replies: Their topics have {count} replies by other members: with “Delete content too” they are deleted as well.
notes.bans_kept: {count} email / IP bans stay active, no longer tied to the account.
notes.ban_moves: The source has an active account ban: after the merge it applies to the target too.
notes.staff_dropped: The source's staff roles and own permissions ({count}) are not moved.
notes.profile_kept: The source's profile (fields, signature, appearance) is not moved: the target keeps its own.
notes.vip_moves: The source's VIP ({tier}, until: {until}) moves to the target.
notes.vip_source_longer: The source's VIP ({tier}, until: {until}) is longer and is kept; the target's is closed.
notes.vip_target_kept: The target's VIP ({tier}, until: {until}) is kept; the source's is closed.
notes.clan_successor: Leads the clan [{tag}] {clan}: leadership passes to {name}.
notes.clan_archived: Leads the clan [{tag}] {clan} with no other members: the clan is archived.
notes.clans_move: The source's clans ({tags}) move to the target, with the roles.
notes.clans_target_kept: The target is already in clans ({tags}): those stay, and the source leaves {dropped}.
notes.game_unlinked: {count} game identities are unlinked; their stats, ELO and matches stay.

merge.keeps: The target keeps its name, email, password, 2FA, groups, settings and profile.
merge.noLogins: The source has no sign-in accounts.
merge.loginMove: moves to the target (the target can sign in with it)

merge.confirmLabel: Type the source account's name to confirm: {name}

uninstall.doneKept: {name} was uninstalled; its data was kept.

goals.lead: A goal’s progress = the confirmed donations of its period, in its currency. The “Monthly goal” widget shows the first active goal by default.

features.plugin: A plugin that posts through the bot (“bot.post” capability).

welcome_pm.title: Welcome message
welcome_pm.body: A private message sent to every new member right after sign-up.

moderation_notes.title: Moderation notes
moderation_notes.body: When a moderator moves, locks or archives a topic and picks “Note from the bot”, the bot posts the note in the topic.

scheduled.body: The posts written below, published by the bot at the chosen time.

bans.title: Bans

new.title: New ban
new.body: On an account (the member's name), an IP or a range (e.g. 203.0.113.0/24), an email or a whole domain (e.g. @spam-mail.com). The ban also applies at sign-up and sign-in.

bans.liftConfirm: The ban is lifted at once; the person gets access back.

settings.title: Acknowledging warnings
settings.ack: The member must acknowledge the warning before posting again
settings.ackHint: Until they acknowledge it (on the “My warnings” page), the member can't write posts, private messages, chat messages or status updates.
settings.whoCanWarn: Staff with edit rights on Warnings (ACP roles) can warn, and in chat the moderators with the warn right.

reasons.title: Preset reasons
reasons.body: They show up on the member's card: pick a reason and its points and expiry fill in by themselves.
reasons.name: Reason (e.g. Spam)
reasons.deleteConfirm: The reason leaves the list; warnings already given stay.

thresholds.title: Thresholds
thresholds.body: When active points reach a threshold: posts need approval, the member can't post, or gets banned. No duration = as long as the points stay above the threshold.
thresholds.deleteConfirm: The threshold is deleted; restrictions it applied are lifted at the next warning or on expiry.

stats.title: Defense in the last 30 days: {count} blocks

captcha.title: Registration
captcha.body: The proof-of-work captcha is built in: the browser does a little computing work in the background, with no third-party scripts and no images to guess.
captcha.turnstileHint: Turnstile keys are set in Settings › Login & Registration.
captcha.qa: Also ask a question (if there are questions)

questions.question: Question
questions.deleteConfirm: The question is deleted for good.

newMembers.title: New members
newMembers.body: Restrictions apply during the first days after registration or until a number of approved posts. Leave both at 0 to turn them off.

newMembers.pms: Private messages per day (0 = no limit)
newMembers.approval: All new members' posts need approval

phishing.title: Anti-phishing
phishing.body: Links to domains that imitate Steam / Discord or are on the list are refused in posts, chat, private messages, statuses and signatures; clicking an old link shows a warning page first. The shipped list has {count} domains.

sfs.body: At registration, the IP and email are checked against the StopForumSpam database (the result is cached for 24 h). The API key is only needed to report marked spammers.
sfs.keySet: saved — leave empty to keep it

shared.title: Shared IPs (multiple accounts)
shared.body: IPs used by several accounts in the last 30 days; those with a banned or spammer account come first. They can also be families or internet cafés. Staff get a notification when a new account shares another account's IP.

retention.title: Keeping IPs (GDPR)
retention.body: After the chosen number of days, IPs in posts, private messages, statuses, logs, devices, sessions and accounts are erased daily. IP bans stay. 0 = keep them.

image.hint: PNG, WebP, GIF or SVG (checked automatically), up to {kb} KB; stored as WebP of at most {px} px.

preview.title: Live preview

widget.title: Widget look
widget.heading: Look: {name}
widget.none: No plugin or app adds look options for widgets.

terms.title: Terms of use

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.hint: The public page /privacy or an external address, linked in the footer, at registration and in the cookie banner.

retention.title: Data retention
